stages.title: The platinum
stages.body: Vice Got a Price! checks for the other 54 trophies. There is no multiplayer list and no add-on requirement, so one story run plus the post-finale free-roam sweep covers everything. Manual saves are your only undo because missions cannot be replayed.

stages.title: Prologue and Chapter 1 — first steps in Leonida
stages.body: Gone Fishing is the opening mission and the first bronze; Discharge Time is where Chapter 1 stops. The balcony meditation at Jason's home exists only here, and the early vehicle scans quietly start the count toward Whip It Good and the 100% checklist.

stages.title: Chapter 2 — reaching Vice City
stages.body: The chapter closes on T**s Ass Drug Money. Coffee Break turns on partner free-roam, which unlocks Hot Together, Retail Therapy and Personal Best; Breakfast Run has its own trophy. Daily Driver installs the property app for Little Boxes, and Moses brings On the Spot.

stages.title: Chapter 3 — the heist and the fences
stages.body: Vice City, Baby! lands around The Cartel Heist. Credit Check hands over the dye-pack jammer, opening Dime on the Dollar and making Little Cuba Payday Loans fair game for Bad Luck, I Guess. Yasmani's jewelry work starts both Sneakthief and the three-shop spree.

stages.title: Chapter 4 — airport and vaults
stages.body: Top Of The World, Ma, Family Matters, DWNFALL and Hi-Jacked are all inside Chapter 4, which ends at Starting From Zero. That's Where The Money Is… opens the large vaults near the close, bringing Maximum Withdrawal, A Classic Blitz Play and often Hot Together with it.

stages.title: Chapter 5 — Savage Glory to the credits
stages.body: Operation Savage Glory carries Snow Storm, then the story runs through Honest Abe, Unfinished Business, Protective Custody and The End of the Road. You Gotta Know When to Get Off is the finale. PowerPyx attaches it to Starting From Zero in one place and to Chapter 5 in another; the last mission is the real trigger either way.

stages.title: Free-roam — the completion checklist
stages.body: The 100% page unlocks only once the story is done, but earlier progress is counted. It asks for roughly 60% of the game: 100 optional tasks, 39 gang operations, every bank job, every shooting range gold, every drone race and Bret's hunting decks, while collectibles are only partly required. None of it can be missed.
stages.counts: 100% · 39 gang ops · 22 bank jobs · 42 drone races

stages.title: Cleanup — one-off actions
stages.body: What remains are single stunts rather than long grinds: a rooftop cocktail on Ocean Beach, a Banshee through a showroom window, a tank at Mile Zero, a 2 a.m. UFO, a bowling score, ten riders knocked off a bike. They pop immediately and none can be lost.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This one appears the instant the 54th companion trophy is earned. No online mode and no paid expansion stand in the way, so a single story run followed by the free-roam sweep is the whole plan.

steps.text: Follow the stage order: five story chapters, then the 100% page, then the loose one-off actions. Nothing requires a second campaign.
Keep a manual save at both ends of every chapter. With no mission replay, a save file is the only route back into an earlier story beat.
Save the grind-heavy awards for the end; the completion checklist tends to finish most of them as a side effect.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Gone Fishing bridges the prologue and the first chapter and doubles as a tutorial for the controls. Finish the mission and the bronze is automatic; no optional objective is attached.

steps.text: Continue the opening mission chain until Gone Fishing starts, then see it through. The award appears on the mission results screen.
This lands within the first hour, before the map opens up. Nothing you skip around it affects the trophy.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Chapter 1 stretches from Gone Fishing through the Brian and Donnie work to Recalibration, Tourist Trap, Home Sweet Home and Discharge Time. PowerPyx records the award arriving as Chapter 2's opener, What's in the Bag?, begins rather than at the chapter's own last mission.

steps.text: Chase the pink story markers through Chapter 1 and complete Discharge Time. The chapter bronze is handed out when Chapter 2 starts.
Before leaving the chapter, sit for the balcony meditation at Jason's house. It is the only part of the game that expires with Chapter 1.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Chapter 2 follows the move to Vice City: Pancake work, Moses and the crawler, Breakfast Run, Coffee Break and the drive to Checking Out. The chapter award shows up when Welcome to Vice City opens the next chapter.

steps.text: Drive the main story through Checking Out (Move to Vice City). The trophy is granted while Chapter 3's first mission loads.
Pick up Breakfast Run's own trophy on the way; that mission is part of this chapter's required list.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Chapter 3 is the robbery chapter: Yasmani's jewelers, Raul's crew, the Sinfrontera bank scouting and The Cartel Heist. According to PowerPyx the award settles after Chapter 4 opens with Ocean Beach and Another Life.

steps.text: Finish The Cartel Heist, then keep playing into Chapter 4 until Ocean Beach and Another Life are both complete. The trophy lands there.
Credit Check is not optional for completionists: the dye-pack jammer it unlocks enables marked-bill laundering and sits behind two other trophies.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Chapter 4 is the longest run: airport heist preparation, Child's Play, Headliners, VCIA Takedown and the quiet stretch after. Its chapter award is tied to finishing Starting From Zero.

steps.text: Play Chapter 4's story through Starting From Zero and complete it. That mission closes the chapter and delivers the trophy.
That's Where The Money Is… sits near the end of the chapter and is the switch that enables the large bank vaults, so do not rush past it.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: The gold goes with the last story mission. PowerPyx ties the unlock to Starting From Zero in one table while its chapter list puts the finale in Chapter 5; since the trigger is simply the final mission, play until the credits and it will arrive.

steps.text: Complete Chapter 5's final mission, which follows Protective Custody. No particular choice is needed and the award cannot be failed.
The two references name different missions; both agree it is story-bound and unavoidable.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Breakfast Run is a Chapter 2 mission in which Jason visits Lucia and the pair's cover story becomes a little more solid. Finishing it hands over the bronze with no extra condition.

steps.text: Follow Chapter 2's story in order; Breakfast Run comes after Daily Driver. Clear it and the trophy shows on the results page.
There is no optional objective, score or alternate ending inside this mission.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: The Cartel Heist is Chapter 3's centrepiece: scouting Sinfrontera National Bank, practicing on a safe, gathering explosives and then running the job itself. It ends the chapter's main line.

steps.text: Complete each [The Cartel Heist] preparation mission the story offers, then launch the heist from the planning room and finish it.
Every scouting step is story-locked, so the trophy cannot slip out of reach.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Child's Play is Chapter 4's rescue mission. It becomes available after Fresh Evidence and is played as Jason; finishing it awards the bronze.

steps.text: Follow Chapter 4's story markers past Fresh Evidence and complete Child's Play (Rescue Rafa from Kidnappers).
It overlaps the VCIA Takedown preparation, so avoid parking the story halfway through the airport setup.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Headliners is the Chapter 4 launch-party job, sitting between the airport preparation and the heist. Jason helps run the event.

steps.text: Complete Headliners in Chapter 4, just before VCIA Takedown. The trophy unlocks on completion.
Treat it as a checkpoint: once Headliners is done, only the airport heist and the chapter close remain.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: VCIA Takedown is the airport heist that Chapter 4 spends a dozen prep missions assembling: the catering truck, surveillance, Kordell's crew and Andrea's delivery. Finish the heist for the bronze.

steps.text: Complete all [VCIA Takedown] preparation missions, then begin the airport heist and carry it through.
The heist is story-only and cannot be lost permanently; a failed attempt simply restarts at a checkpoint.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Operation Savage Glory is a Chapter 5 mission placed after VC Baby and before the Honest Abe talks. Completing it awards the bronze.

steps.text: Play Chapter 5 through Bird in the Hand, Taking Liberties and Doggie Bag, then complete Operation Savage Glory.
The trophy is automatic; no decision inside the mission changes it.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The checklist page appears after the story, under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, but work done during the story already counts. It is not every activity in the game: PowerPyx puts it near 60% of the content, with side quests mostly optional and collectibles only partly needed.

steps.text: Finish the story, then open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and read what is still unfilled.
Bank the all-or-nothing requirements: 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, every shooting-range gold, 42 drone races and Bret's 15 hunting decks.
Work the partial counters early: 100 optional tasks, 200 scanned base-model vehicles, 100 studied animals, 300 stunts and 70 of 80 challenges.
No checklist item is missable, so starting late costs only time.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Leonida holds 397 stunts in four groups: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Any 250 qualify, so choose the two quickest categories and repeat them instead of sampling everything.

steps.text: Categories can be mixed freely because the counter is a total. Under-bridge flights give the fastest repeat per attempt.
Watch progress by region under Progress > Activities > Stunts, or by name on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots.
The completion page wants 300, so if the platinum is the goal, keep going past the silver.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Nine activity types are counted: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, video games, winning any race and performing a stunt. One of each is plenty, and the story hands you several without trying.

steps.text: Open Touchpad > Progress > Activities and hover each category to see what is still untouched.
Filter the map for Activities (blue dumbbell icon) and clear whatever is at zero; a single pool game or stunt usually closes the list.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Two ranges hold 12 challenges worth 42 gold medals in total. Pay the $5 waiver at each counter to put the challenges on the map, then gold every one.

steps.text: Visit Griffin Shooting Range and Rodgers Ranch, speak to the clerk and pay the $5 waiver at both so all 12 challenges are marked.
Rent a missing weapon type for $10; rented guns are strong enough for gold on each challenge.
Repeated runs raise Focus permanently, which pays back later in Gunslinger.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Fourteen locations hold three races each, 42 in all. The trophy wants one win per location, while the completion page wants all 42 finished and the first two beaten on par time before the third unlocks.

steps.text: Find the blue Top Fun markers within about 100 metres and win one race at each of the 14 sites.
Keep the stick forward and stay off the scenery; clipping a wall is what destroys par time.
For the checklist, beat par on races one and two so the third appears, then finish it.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Twenty separate races are required, not one circuit twenty times. The map offers 40 distinct race locations, so there is ample slack, and street races, race challenges and drone races all add to the count.

steps.text: Open street racing through Yago's Chapter 3 questline, then work through the race markers on the map.
Change venue every time. Repeats do not move a counter that only tracks distinct races.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After meeting Cal in Chapter 1, he texts a fishing spot west of Key Lento. Show up, accept his challenge and pull in a bigger catch than he does.

steps.text: Complete Feng Shui (Meet Cal) in Chapter 1, then wait for Cal's text and the purple marker west of Key Lento.
Fish the spot and out-catch him. Cal's line is not part of the Strangers & Freaks tally, so treat it as a standalone job.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Four arcade cabinets are in the game: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind and Bang For Your Buck. Three can be played on the TV at home from Chapter 1, and reaching the end of any one of them is enough.

steps.text: Use the controllers at Jason's place in Chapter 1 and choose any of the three home cabinets.
Play through every level and finish the game. High scores and side challenges are irrelevant; only the last stage matters.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's five-part chain is Lucia-only and begins in Chapter 3 with a call, then a text giving her Belville address. The line closes with Puff Puff Pass at the warehouse.

steps.text: Play Chapter 3 as Lucia until Andy calls, then complete Climbing the Cellerichain, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass.
Finish Puff Puff Pass for the trophy. Andy's chain does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, but it stays open after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton runs the treasure-diving line from Key Lento and asks for seven shipwrecks. He goes quiet for a while after Chapter 1, but a call from Jason brings him back in Chapter 2 or 3, so the chain cannot be lost.

steps.text: Begin with Island Dreams in Chapter 1, then dive the marked wrecks with the metal detector and hand in each find.
If Kenton goes silent after Chapter 1, call Brian as Jason in Chapter 2 and he will text you shortly.
Clear all seven wrecks and follow the count under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's mud-club line opens after Coffee Break and is marked at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Five missions end with Hometown Heroes, the one that carries the trophy.

steps.text: Complete Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats and The Impaler, then finish Hometown Heroes.
Billy's line is not one of the Strangers & Freaks counters, so do not expect this trophy to move that number.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Only some side chains feed this counter. PowerPyx's confirmed contributors include Kirk's skunk-ape line, Kyle's McKittrick Farm line and Yago's racing chain; Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy and Billy are explicitly excluded. Eight complete strands are required.

steps.text: Complete Kirk's three jobs: Search for the Skunk Ape, Search for Tree Effigies and Help Kirk Find Mr. Mangrove.
Complete Kyle's three: Check Out McKittrick Farm, Collect Chemicals for Kyle and Buddy?
Add Yago's racing line and any other green-marked chain from the same page until eight strands are done.
Compare the trophy counter before and after a final mission; the game keeps no strand list of its own.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's Wish List opens after Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, the Chapter 3 mission that also gives you the key cloner. He wants 16 named sports cars delivered to his garage in west Vice City.

steps.text: Scan high-end sports cars with WAiNK to check whether each is on the list, then drive it to Randy's garage.
Read the list under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List. A clean delivery pays more, but condition does not gate the trophy.
Search Vice Beach and Ocean Beach, where the wanted cars wait outside hotels and cruise the strip.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's chain opens after Here, Kitty Kitty and is Jason-only. It begins with purple synthetic-lab markers and ends with the mission the trophy is named after, Spin On This.

steps.text: As Jason, work through Take Out Kitty Litter and destroy the marked synthetic labs around Vice City.
Accept Spin On This when Tyrone offers it and complete the mission. The chain remains available in free-roam if you leave it late.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: There are 18 meditations spread over 10 spots, each usable once by Jason and once by Lucia. The one truly missable session is on Jason's balcony during Chapter 1; it disappears when the chapter ends.

steps.text: After Down to Earth, speak to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and accept the meditation lesson. This is the Chapter 1-only one.
Once Coffee Break allows partner play, visit the other nine spots with both characters so every location counts twice.
Follow the running total under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations; the completion page only asks for 15 of the 18.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's hunting line opens for Jason after Coffee Break, starting with Veteran Hunted. He gives you the Killtelligence SM-69 rifle and then sends you after particular animals at the Target Decks.

steps.text: As Jason, answer Bret's text and complete Veteran Hunted in Lummox County to open the chain.
Work the purple hunting markers and Target Decks under Map > Activities; all 15 decks are needed for the 100% page anyway.
PowerPyx still lists the exact animal as unconfirmed, so clear the decks instead of betting on a single hunt.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Eighteen card sets contain 480 cards. Three complete sets earn the trophy, while the completion page asks for 15, meaning about 372 unique cards at minimum.

steps.text: Start with the smallest sets. Backyard Wrestling needs 12 cards and Delights Dancers 18, versus 24 to 30 for most others.
Check yellow phone boxes on walls and tool boxes on flat surfaces; indoor cards sit on shelves and desks.
Sell duplicates without worry; a sale does not erase the card from your collection list.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK targets are outdoor objects marked by a starburst in the phone app: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and the No Flusher tags. Any 100 of those count, and 100 is also the checklist requirement.

steps.text: Walk around with the WAiNK app active; the controller buzzes and a notification points out a scannable object nearby.
Skip AHOL street art and the 1010 murals, which belong to separate collections and do not feed this counter.
Confirm the total under Progress > Collections > WAiNK Locations before calling it done.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Eighty challenges are grouped into eight categories of ten, all open from the start. Fifty earns the trophy and 70 satisfies the completion page, leaving ten that can be ignored.

steps.text: Open Progress > Challenges and hover every entry; finished ones show a checkmark in the corner.
Clear the easy combat and criminal categories first, since they overlap heavily with ordinary robberies and shootouts.
Leave the rest for last; many challenges complete themselves while you hunt other trophies.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: This needs free-roam with both characters, so Coffee Break in Chapter 2 is the gate. Reach four stars with your partner present, then leave the red heat zone, not just the flashing search circle.

steps.text: Call your partner with the d-pad shortcut, then cause enough chaos to reach four stars.
Ride a fast motorcycle through traffic; if a helicopter follows, shoot at it until it peels off.
The train tunnel north of Ambrosia is the dependable escape; the cops lose you on the tracks and the helicopter loses sight.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Three robberies in a row while police stay on you, with your partner along. The wanted level must never clear between shops, and the award can lag half a minute after the third.

steps.text: Wait until after Coffee Break, call your partner and start at the Jewelry Stores in north Vice City once Yasmani's jewelry jobs open.
Carry armor, sticky bombs and healing, and take a couple of items plus the back-room safe in each shop.
If nothing appears after the third, hit a fourth; the counter is forgiving but the delay is real.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Scanning is all that is required; you never have to drive the vehicle. WAiNK unlocks in Chapter 1, so stand beside a busy road and sweep every model that passes.

steps.text: Hold the WAiNK shortcut and scan passing traffic in Vice City; new models register the moment they are scanned.
Check the count under Progress > Vehicles, which splits discoveries by category.
Boats and aircraft count too, so a marina or airfield is worth the detour.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus slows time and highlights weak points for only a few seconds. Five kills in one activation is the target, and civilians or police reportedly do not count, so use gang-operation criminals.

steps.text: Buff focus first by eating, drinking or washing at home, and take Adrenaline to stretch the window.
Line up five criminals at an illegal operation and use an accurate automatic rifle rather than a pistol.
Raise the focus stat through shooting ranges, golf, pool and fishing; level four makes the trophy far easier.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal an airliner parked at a boarding bridge at Vice City International, taxi it to a runway and fly roughly a kilometre away. Planes sitting out on the apron do not work.

steps.text: Go to departure terminal E3/E4, climb the stairs beside the bridge and enter the docked plane.
Get upstairs into the cockpit, reverse onto the airstrip, take off and fly clear of the airport.
Keep flying: the unlock waits until about one kilometre out, so do not land early to check.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The Rhino is a military tank kept at Mile Zero Air Station, the island off the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. Get inside and use the cannon on someone.

steps.text: Reach Mile Zero Air Station; the tanks sit in the southern part of the base.
Drive through the gate or take the stunt jump beside the south-east entrance, then board a tank.
Fire on enemies until the bronze appears.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: The Snap Gun is the key tool because it opens locked doors without setting off the alarm. Use it, take the safe code from the back-room note, loot the safe, then wipe the CCTV and disable the alarm before leaving.

steps.text: Wait until the Snap Gun is in your inventory, then approach a jewelry store's locked rear door and pick the stealth option.
Read the back-room note for the safe combination and open the safe.
Destroy the CCTV and disable the alarm before exiting; the trophy appears shortly after you leave.
Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is the shop PowerPyx points to for this one.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Large bank vaults only appear after That's Where The Money Is… near the end of Chapter 4. Eight exist, five are required here, and all eight are required for the checklist, so the trophy comes along on the way.

steps.text: Complete That's Where The Money Is… to unlock large-bank robberies, then buy vault tips from Yasmani if the vans are not marked.
Tail a security van to its bank, slip in while the vault is open and hand a bag to your partner; you cannot carry it all alone.
Escape the guaranteed four-star response on a fast bike, then switch vehicles so the search drops.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Once the big-vault jobs open up late in Chapter 4, armoured trucks start rolling with cash on board. It is a short, loud job: stop the truck, crack the rear doors and shake the pursuit before the clock of police pressure pins you down.

steps.text: Watch for a moving armoured truck after the heist that unlocks large-bank work; the map tags it once the crew has the gear.
Box the truck in with a heavier vehicle, pop the guards and grab the bags — the driver will not stop on his own.
Break line of sight quickly and change cars at the first safe gap; the wanted level will not cool while you sit in the getaway vehicle.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Leonida is split into a handful of regions, and this award simply wants a visit to each one. There is no order and no time limit, so it can be chipped away during ordinary travel between missions.

steps.text: Open the map and tick off each named region as you cross it; the north-west parks and the southern keys are the pair players most often leave for last.
Do the sweep after the story is finished, when every road and airfield is open and fast travel is not needed.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: The 39 illegal operations are spread across the city's rival crews. This one only asks for a single job against each gang, which is far less work than the 100% page demands — do not confuse the two counters.

steps.text: Use the criminal-activity map filter to sort operations by the crew that runs them, then pick the closest job for each gang in turn.
Hit each site the same way: clear the guards quietly, grab the marked valuable and leave before reinforcements arrive.
Count crews, not jobs — one operation per gang is enough here, while the full checklist later wants every operation finished.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: A pure sightseeing award: order a drink at the Ocean Beach rooftop bar and let the camera do the rest. The prompt only appears on the terrace, not at street level.

steps.text: Head to the Ocean Beach strip in the evening and take the lift or stairs to the rooftop bar above the promenade.
Order the cocktail from the bartender and stay for the cutscene; the trophy lands as the glass is raised, so do not walk away mid-prompt.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: An old-fashioned stunt: find the high-end car showroom with the glass front, drive something heavy through it and leave through the hole you made. It opens up once the city end of Chapter 3 is reachable.

steps.text: Wait until Chapter 3 has sent the crew into the city centre, then mark the showroom on the map so you approach from the right street.
Borrow a fast, weighty car from the forecourt or bring a truck; a compact will bounce off the reinforced glass.
Line up straight on, hit the window at full speed and keep rolling — stopping inside the display floor loses the moment.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: The Kolt & Associates bowling alley doubles as a money-laundering front, and the job that pays this trophy is a small, contained robbery rather than a full heist. Bring a partner: the alley is staffed.

steps.text: Reach Chapter 2 and take the call that points you at Kolt & Associates; the alley only opens as a target once that contact is live.
Walk in through the front desk, take the back corridor past the lanes and open the office safe behind the counter.
Clear the staff before the alarm finishes ringing; the narrow lanes leave no cover once the response arrives.
Leave through the loading door at the rear and lose the pursuit in the surrounding blocks — the same building later counts toward gang-operation progress.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Partner activities unlock after Coffee Break, and this one asks for a strong showing rather than a win. Any of the co-op challenges counts as long as you beat the target score attached to it.

steps.text: Finish Coffee Break in Chapter 2 so free-roam with a partner becomes available, then call them from the phone.
Pick an activity with a visible score target and play it twice: the first run teaches the controls, the second is for the number.
Stay partnered for the whole attempt; leaving the session or swapping companions resets the score you were building.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: A story-choice award. Several conversations in the campaign let you pick a side, and this one is granted the first time you commit to a branch instead of backing out of the prompt.

steps.text: When a dialogue wheel appears, pick an option and let the scene play out rather than pressing back for the neutral line.
Do it once on purpose after the story is done if you played cautiously; the choice prompts repeat in free-roam encounters and cannot be failed.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: One branch of the Chapter 3 robbery chain goes wrong on purpose, and the trophy rewards you for going back for a second attempt. The dye-pack jammer from Credit Check makes the retry survivable.

steps.text: Play the Little Cuba payday-loan job during Chapter 3 and let the first attempt fail rather than reloading a save.
Collect the dye-pack jammer handed over in Credit Check so the marked bills do not ruin the second run.
Return to the same branch and finish the job cleanly; the award is tied to the retry, not the first failure.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: The strangest free-roam encounter in Leonida is time-gated: a light in the sky over the north-west desert that only shows itself in the small hours. Bring a vehicle that can climb and a camera.

steps.text: Wait for night and drive into the desert region north-west of the city; the event has a narrow window rather than a fixed marker.
Climb to high ground around 2 a.m. and look up — the object appears low over the horizon before it moves.
Follow it rather than filming from the car; the encounter resolves only when you are on foot underneath it.
Stay until the scene ends. Walking away early leaves the event unmarked and it will not offer a second prompt that night.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: A joke award for a joke move: strike a pedestrian with a melee swing from a moving vehicle. It works anywhere there are people on the pavement, so the beach promenade is the easiest stage.

steps.text: Drive slowly along a busy pavement and press the melee attack while the vehicle is still rolling.
Aim for someone walking away from you; a head-on target tends to step aside before the swing lands.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Marked bills are the tainted take from bank jobs, and they are only worth a fraction until a contact washes them. The trophy wants a quarter of a million in clean money, so this is a running total across several jobs rather than a single score.

steps.text: Bank every marked-bill payout instead of spending it; the laundering counter only tracks what reaches a contact.
Keep robbing steadily through Chapter 4 — every bank job adds marked bills to the pile, and the total is what matters rather than one big score.
Hand the bills to your fence in batches and keep going past the first $250k threshold, because early laundering fees trim the total.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Six figures of pure retail therapy, counted across every shop in the state. Clothes, ammo and car parts all count, so it can be finished without wasting money on anything you would not buy anyway.

steps.text: Spread the spending across different shop types instead of dumping it all into one store; the counter is shared, but variety stops you from hitting a single-shop cap.
Time the spree after the bank jobs, when the funds are in hand and the shops in the wealthier districts stock the expensive items.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Eight of Leonida's twelve garages can be bought outright for about $160,000 in total. The property app arrives during Chapter 2, and each purchase adds parking slots as well as progress here.

steps.text: Finish Daily Driver in Chapter 2 to install the property app, then open its garage listings from the phone.
Buy the cheap garages first and use the extra slots for the vehicles you are registering to the scooter app.
Keep buying until all eight purchasable garages are owned; the four remaining garages are story rewards and are not part of the count.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Moses brings the Scooter Bros delivery app in Chapter 2, and registering ten vehicles to it is a delivery-side chore rather than a race. Duplicates do not count, so ten distinct rides are needed.

steps.text: Complete the Moses mission in Chapter 2 so the delivery app appears on the phone.
Register each vehicle at a garage rather than on the street; the app only accepts rides stored in a slot you own.
Log ten different models. Re-registering the same car after a respray still counts once, so swap vehicles between registrations.
